gapNote: Verified against the sources above: she finished among the ten Ballon d'Or 2026 finalists, behind winner Alexia Putellas. Her exact placing (second) could not be confirmed from any source opened, so the page does not claim it. UEFA confirms she was the official Player of the Match in the 2026 final (4-0 over OL Lyonnes, Oslo, 23 May 2026) and the 2025/26 Champions League top scorer with 11 goals. Useful angle: her Champions League final record, six finals before the first win.
